title: Certify a whole-word internal grid for the physical P104 dual
body:
## Summary

PR2674's physical P104 grid certificate stops at atomic instructions. PR2754 implements one collector internally but assumes its entrance grid. This adds a source-bound sufficient grid for every native prefix in the unchanged 5,398-event PR2586 word, including all eight strict-zero private erasures.

```text
atomic grid B(lambda) = max(10 lambda, 9 lambda + 2)
  + at most 4 lambda internal Gaussian bits
  = max(14 lambda, 13 lambda + 2) extra fractional bits
  -> exact whole-word integer execution and zero erasure
```

Fifteen extra bits suffice for one 512-coordinate layer. Unitary prefixes retain the predecessor's stored-component range bound; four-term scratch needs two more magnitude bits. The package includes the proof, immutable inputs, exact provenance, complete expanded caller, separate canonical-chart endpoint oracle, failure controls and registered replay.

Scientific base is main `31452ecd309f32a97e2e84214719b21297a59018`, priority revision 5. Current upstream and overlap freshness are recorded in TASK.json. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2750#discussioncomment-18958803).

Credit Arham Tahir/PR2674 and PR2665, ywz65/PR2586 and PR2730, Nick Petalas/PR2754 and PR2549/2550, Alejandro Zarzuelo Urdiales's Gaussian parity methods, and the retained native/compiler/P104 lineage. Prior atomic bounds and Gaussian arithmetic are identified as retained results. Assistance is disclosed in TASK.json.

## Evidence

- Before: native internal execution and exact rounded-prefix supply were explicitly outside the predecessor atomic certificate. A six-bit whole-word fixture rejects an inexact internal halving.
- After: all 1,245 native records bind all 2,070 occurrences. Exact logical replay checks 5,748 boundaries and 103,145 nonzero terms. Two internally quantized executions match all 716 public endpoints against the separate oracle and check all eight erasures each. Five semantic faults reject.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay and four package test groups pass, including Git-free isolated optimized execution, exact Fraction arithmetic, typed/source corruption and overwrite refusal. All 74 research-workflow tests pass with seven skips. Ruff E/F/B and warning-as-error compilation pass. A separate internal reviewer checked the proof and ran the optimized replay; no independent human or formal-kernel review is claimed.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-whole-word-internal-grid
```

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: research.

Only `research/p104-whole-word-internal-grid/` is added. The common grid is conservative, not a minimal format or a performance improvement. Native operator correctness and tensor lifting remain inherited; physical fixtures execute one tensor layer. The full-vector Python interpreter and exponential scalar expansion do not establish recursive-child complexity, efficient storage/tape access, hosting, other corrections, all-size supplier admission or a favorable complete supplier. No new kappa, selected-frontier change, full multiplication theorem or hosted-CI success is claimed.
